simple.summary: נֵד (nêd) means a mound , i.e. wave First listed occurrence: Exod 15 8.

definitions.full: H5067. ned נֵד noun masculine Josh 3:13 heap of waters; of Red Sea Exod 15:8 (song), Psa 78:13 ; of Jordan Josh 3:13 , 16 ; Psa 33:7 (simile). קָצִיר נֵד Isa 17:11 harvest-heap is perhaps corrupt: Ges Ew Di Du derive from נוד , reading (probably) נָד (Di) fled is the harvest ; Che Hpt proposes לָכֵן therefore ; Buhl Lex 13 עַד , after ᵑ7 ᵐ5 .
